title: Serratia marcescens BJL200 secretome
projectDescription: Study the secretome of Serratia marcescens BJL200 upon growth on chitin.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Bacteria was grown on agarose plates with chitin or glucose (control) as sole carbon source. samples were collected from the the bottom on the agarose disc, and samples were trypsinated directly after freezing, thawing and crushing of agar. Zip-tip and LC-MS analysis (QExactive).
dataProcessingProtocol: Quantification using MaxLFQ algorithm in MaxQuant and bioinformatics using Perseus and servers for annotation of subcellular location.
